title: Taller than 11 ft 4 in? This tunnel says no #Shorts
description:
Zion's tunnel was built for 1920s cars. One window was closed by ice, another by a rockslide in 1958, and anything over 11 feet 4 inches tall needs a permit and one-way traffic.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 3: The Impossible Tunnel): https://youtu.be/30zzYRt_Mgk
